newsitem.title: USA: Vermont jobless rate rises to 4.5 pct in October.
newsitem.headline: Vermont jobless rate rises to 4.5 pct in October.

text.p: The Vermont Department of Employment & Training Tuesday reported a seasonally adjusted state unemployment rate of 4.5 percent for October, up 1/10 of a percentage point from September.

"Unemployment continued to increase in October while job growth remained modest," Department Commissioner Susan Auld said in a release. "Although the state unemployment rate remains well below the national rate, the gap has narrowed in recent months as Vermont unemployment has increased."
The comparable rate for the United States in October was 5.2 percent, unchanged from the prior month.

October jobless rates for Vermont's 13 labor markets ranged from 1.7 percent in Hartford-Lebanon to 8.3 percent in Newport. Labor market area rates are not seasonally adjusted. For comparison, the unadjusted rate for Vermont was 4.0 percent.
